facts.fact: 教授死讯晨间处置：发电报给兄弟（已死）、请医生签死亡证明、Beto 也得来
facts.anchor: He’ll have to sign a death certificate

facts.fact: 宿醉揭晓杀错人的偶然性：当晚 Perla 嫌雪莉酒劲薄喝了私藏龙舌兰——毒酒一口没碰
facts.anchor: she had availed herself of one of her secret bottles of tequila

facts.fact: Carrel 医生找到安眠药+酒，宣布「这是谋杀」要逮捕无照卖药的药剂师 Facundo Alamilla
facts.anchor: Nepomuceno has been murdered by the pharmacist!

facts.fact: 遗书实锤自杀定性：病了几个月一心求死；怀表和书遗赠 Inés，还有那条狗
facts.anchor: bequeathing his silver-plated pocket watch and his books to Inés

facts.fact: Perla 与神父砍价葬礼：「多一公斤肥膘加三比索」砍成本地安葬、无守灵
facts.anchor: “You can’t be charging me for the man as though he were a chunk of meat at the butcher shop,” Perla said.

facts.fact: 她翻检死者遗物想捞值钱的被 Inés 撞见；拒绝给侄女安慰「接着过日子」
facts.anchor: “He was an old drunk and now he’s dead, it’s no surprise.

facts.fact: 闪回：Encarnación 收到戏服工厂录用电报要再度离家；Perla 怒极推人——她坠梯无声死去
facts.anchor: She unclasps her trembling hands and shoves Encarnación away.

facts.fact: 年幼 Inés 端着布娃娃目睹全程；Perla 掐她双臂险些掐死，最后抱住她哭——封口
facts.anchor: She saw me push her, Perla thinks.
